criterion.en: Host observer defender-display-v3.ps1. Add only the absolute workspace/ArenaSafety/defender-exclusion path from host target.json, verify a true red PRESENT hold, hold 10 seconds, then remove it and verify ABSENT. Elevation and read failures are execution failures, not protection findings.
